name: search_issues
description: Searches the repository's issues with filters (state, labels, assignee, author, milestone, inactivity, keywords) and returns their numbers.

arguments.name: labels
arguments.description: Only issues that have all of these labels, e.g. ["bug"].

arguments.name: assignee
arguments.description: Login of the person the issues are assigned to. "@me" means the current user.

arguments.name: unassigned
arguments.description: Only issues that nobody is assigned to.

arguments.name: author
arguments.description: Login of the person who opened the issues. "@me" means the current user.

arguments.name: no_milestone
arguments.description: Only issues that are not in any milestone.

arguments.name: text
arguments.description: Words to look for in the title and body.

arguments.name: inactive_days
arguments.description: Only issues with no activity in the last N days (stale issues).

arguments.name: sort
arguments.description: Order: "created", "updated", "comments" or "reactions" (highest first). Default: best match.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.description: Maximum number of issues to return (1-100, default 30).

examples: Issues with no activity in 60 days
Open issues that mention login timeout
